ov: Black birds of the genus Corvus, which includes the ravens. Crows are among the most intelligent birds: they make and use tools, recognise individual human faces and warn each other about threats.
rg: Species live across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and North America; the American crow lives across most of North America.
df: Omnivores: insects, seeds, nuts and small animals, and occasionally carrion.
fx: A group of crows is called a “murder”.
